name: Montreal Forced Aligner
role: Kaldi CLI that aligns a known transcript to speech: word and phone timings as JSON or TextGrid
notes: 2026-11-27: lead (prospects/inbox/2026-11-24-discovery.md) said MIT, v3.4.4, conda-forge osx-arm64; conda-forge noarch 3.4.4 resolved and ran. The lead said JSON output was unverified: `--output_format json` works and writes tiers `words` and `phones`.
2026-11-27: pretrained english_us_arpa acoustic model and dictionary (v3.0.0) are CC BY 4.0 per mfa-models.readthedocs.io; downloaded by `mfa model download` into MFA_ROOT_DIR, about 95 MB.
2026-11-27: fixture examples/mfa-forced-alignment passes: 10/10 starts within 0.20 s (max 0.10 s) on the sentence where echogarden DTW got 8/10; two runs identical.

evidence.result: mfa align with english_us_arpa model and dictionary (v3.0.0) on a known 10-word transcript of macOS say speech with 0.4 s gaps: words in reference order, starts non-decreasing, 10/10 starts within 0.20 s of known onsets (mean 0.03 s, max 0.10 s), two separate runs identical to 1 ms. micromamba env from conda-forge, models via mfa model download, all under output/.
evidence.scope: One generated sentence, say voice Samantha, english_us_arpa only, word tier only, macOS arm64, conda-forge env. Not real recordings, noise, other languages, G2P, phone timings or speed.

summary: Command-line forced aligner built on Kaldi. Given audio and its exact transcript it writes word and phone timings (JSON or Praat TextGrid), with pretrained acoustic models and dictionaries downloaded by name. Installed through conda-forge; tight on gapped speech where DTW aligners drift.
use_when: A final narration script must be timed word by word, or per phone for syllable-level kinetic type
Word starts must stay tight around pauses, which DTW aligners such as echogarden lose
avoid_when: The transcript is not known: use whisperx or whisper-cpp to transcribe first
Need mouth-shape cues or no conda install: use rhubarb-lip-sync
license: MIT (code); english_us_arpa acoustic model and dictionary CC BY 4.0, other models checked separately

assessment.rationale: Free software (MIT) with free models (CC BY 4.0). Conda route works unattended from ignored output/. Passed all four predeclared checks where echogarden's DTW engine did not.
